messages:
carmen: Heads-up — proposing we add a preemptive canary throttle to avoid runaway cost/latency during early rollouts. Idea: if error rate OR p95 latency OR token-cost spike exceeds thresholds in the first 10m, automatically reduce traffic to 5% and notify customer-ops + oncall.

ryan: agree. Can you propose concrete thresholds? We should keep automatic vs manual split.

carmen: Draft thresholds: first 10m: >3% 5xx OR p95 latency >1200ms OR token cost >2x baseline -> throttle to 5% for 15m. If metric normalizes -> step up to 25% then normal ramp. If persists after 30m -> rollback. Thoughts?

li: Keep per-tenant baseline for token cost (not global). Also account for bursty workloads — suggest moving avg over 3m + second check on 1m instantaneous to avoid flapping.

dalia: Add requirement that telemetry includes sampled prompts and model_variant_id. We need to correlate quality regressions with rollout. Also ops runbook: contact customer-ops + PM on any auto-throttle.

ops-bot: @channel Canary started for feature-flag: new-routing-v2 at 2025-03-12T10:03Z. Traffic slice=2%, owners=@carmen @ryan

ryan: For kill switch, prefer two-tier: soft throttle (auto reduce) + hard kill (manual) with explicit comms. Soft should be reversible by auto-unthrottle if metrics return to baseline.

carmen: Agreed. Proposed runbook steps: 1) auto-throttle triggers -> post to #product + #eng-oncall + page SRE with title 'canary-throttle' 2) collect sampled prompts + logs -> 5 min window 3) if unthrottle conditions met -> auto step-up 4) if persists after 30m -> PM decision to rollback.

sre-bot: Pager scheduled to oncall@sre for incidents matching 'canary-throttle' with severity low->medium.

dalia: Also add A/B guard: keep treatment group size fixed, run shadow traffic at full slice for evaluation where possible. Surface quality-regression metrics to APM (embedding/cosine drift, hallucination rate).

ryan: Implementation notes for eng-runtime: simple policy config in rollout config: `throttle_policy: {window_mins:10, thresholds: {errors_pct:3, p95_ms:1200, cost_mult:2}, actions: [{type:"throttle", target_pct:5, duration_mins:15}, {type:"rollback", condition:"persist_30m"}]}`

carmen: Nice. Can eng estimate effort? Also need product acceptance: telemetry, runbook doc, customer-ops playbook, tests in canary harness.

li: Estimate: ~2 sprint-weeks to add policy engine + 1 sprint-day for dashboarding alerts. Can be feature-flag gated.

carmen: OK blocking items: 1) telemetry schema for cost & model_variant_id (owner @dalia) 2) runtime policy PR (owner @ryan) 3) customer-ops playbook + alert text (owner @maria) 4) QA harness test (owner @eng-test). Can owners ack?

maria: I can own customer-ops playbook. Will draft today.

dalia: I'll own telemetry schema. Will post PR tomorrow.

ryan: I'll own runtime PR. ETA end of next week.

eng-test: Will add a harness test; need a runtime branch. ETA 4 days after runtime PR.

carmen: Great. Let's reconvene Thurs 9am PT to sign off. If any blockers ping me. :thumbsup:

maria: ack

dalia: ack

ryan: ack

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary window for new-routing-v2 2025-03-13T10:00Z -> 2025-03-13T12:00Z

carmen: added action item in roadmap doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/feature/new-routing-v2

li: one more note — we should expose a per-tenant opt-out flag in case customers want to holdback. That needs legal review for contracts. Filing follow-up.

carmen: noted. filing follow-up ticket.
